cardKey.description: The card the links are created on. If not given, the card that includes this macro.

direction.description: Outbound links go from the card to the picked item, inbound links the other way. Defaults to 'outbound'.

linkType.description: Name of the link type to create

linkDescription.description: Description prefilled on each link. Only for link types that allow link descriptions.

buttonLabel.description: The label of the button. For example, 'Link decisions'.

query.description: Logic program that lists the items to pick from. Card rows need 'cardType'; external items need 'connector' and 'itemKey'.
